highlights: Day trip to Versailles (book in advance)
notes: Le Marais hotel ideal for walking to major sites. RER B from CDG is the best airport connection. Avoid taxis from CDG — significantly more expensive.

highlights: Day trip to Nikko via JR Pass
notes: JR Pass saves money on day trips. Book teamLab well in advance. Suica card covers all local transit. Asakusa area great for traditional experience.

highlights: Metropolitan Museum of Art — full day
High Line walk + Chelsea Market lunch
Staten Island Ferry for Statue of Liberty views (free)
notes: OMNY 7-day pass covers all subway and buses. Museum Mile on Fridays often has free/reduced entry. Book popular restaurants 2 weeks ahead.
